issue.title: Enforce AGENTS.md in GitHub: blocking sensitive-path check, same-SHA QA/review status check, enforced model routing
issue.description:
From the graph review approved by Blaine (Oct 17, 2026), fix 1.

Problem: the merge conditions, one writer per PR, the repair cap and the Opus trigger are prose in AGENTS.md. `secret-scan.yml` says sensitive paths are in "Report mode: this does not block merging."

## Acceptance criteria

1. The sensitive-class/sensitive-path check moves from report mode to blocking, following the [OVD-844](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-844/sensitive-class-detector-for-prs)/845 path ([optomachina/Overdrafter#813](https://linear.app/overdrafter/review/ovd-844-sensitive-class-detector-for-prs-report-mode-6451b1ca88af) stack first).
2. A status check verifies that QA's verdict and the review state are for the PR head SHA. This makes the same-SHA merge rule enforced, not a convention.
3. Model routing is enforced: [optomachina/Overdrafter#831](https://linear.app/overdrafter/review/docsagent-graph-add-model-label-routing-config-ad402180abe0) (model-routing.yaml) lands, then a CI check fails if a PR is missing a model: label or has one that disagrees with routing. Coordinate with [OVD-919](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-919/agent-graph-capability-tiers-and-automatic-modelprovider-failover-when).
4. Prepare the exact branch-protection and required-check diff as a document (current vs proposed JSON plus the gh api commands). Do NOT apply it. Blaine's card is required at apply time, routed through Grok Bot.
5. Tests for each new check, with a dry run against the last 20 merged PRs showing no false blocks.

Owner: Release designs the protection diff, Engineer builds the checks (Codex pool), QA verifies. Jev triage first. This is sensitive and governance work, so it needs Blaine's card.
